hooks.name: Keep the spec in sync after a task
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, Kiro type-checks the project and updates the spec files so they keep matching the code.

action.prompt: A spec task was just completed. Before moving on: (1) run `npm run type-check` and fix any errors; (2) make sure `.kiro/specs/athena/tasks.md` marks the task done and lists any follow-up work you found; (3) if the change altered behaviour described in `requirements.md` or `design.md`, update those files so the spec still matches the code.
